chapter: Miss America and the Goodman Russia tour
title: Back to Broadway shows after ABC
summary: Within two weeks of the staff ending he plays Lorelei, Shenandoah, Timbuktu and Man of La Mancha.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: All right. Let’s go back to the mid-’70s, after the job at ABC ended. Did you then start making a living from jingles and doing all that?

I did some of that, but I went back to the theaters. I went back and did Lorelei, the Carol Channing show. I did that, and I was working with one of my dear friends, Dick Perry, who was a first trumpet player. I did that show. Then what did I do? I did Shenandoah, and I did Timbuktu, the Eartha Kitt show. I also did Peter Pan for a very short time, when it opened. I did Angel, another show that folded. And I did the Liv Ullmann show for a short time. So that’s where I went immediately after. I was lucky, because within – I don’t think it was more than two weeks after the staff thing went that I started to play that other show.
Wow. So you really didn’t have much of a break at all.
No. And I did Man of La Mancha with Richard Kiley the second time around. I did that.
So that was what really kept you going in those years.
Yeah, that did it, and we were still doing some jingles. But the jingle business had begun to go down.
